text:
jess_pm: Heads-up: kicking off design for a new paid feature "Guaranteed Throughput Lane" (GTL). Aim: simple buy-for-lane (per-route) that guarantees throughput and tail latency for live endpoints. Need product/eng/ops/legal/finance input on packaging and launch criteria.

liam_eng: Tech notes: doable but several pieces: admission control at the edge, dedicated worker pool tagging, and metrics plumbing. We'll need a cheap fastpath for pilots (no full autoscaler integration). Estimate: pilot-internal MVP in ~8 weeks if we reuse existing routing tags.

omar_sre: Operational constraints: we must avoid noisy neighbor impact. Suggest we implement hard caps per-tenant worker slices and a grace queuing policy. Also want an automated escalation to best-effort route + alerting.

rae_sales: Field feedback: customers hate per-token complexity. They prefer a simple monthly SKU mapping to an RPS bucket — e.g., "Lane-200" = 200 reserved RPS. Also ask for a usage dashboard so they can see wasted reservation vs actual.

norm_finance: For revenue modeling, banded SKUs are easiest. We'll need to estimate utilization at launch. Suggest initial bands: 50, 200, 1000 RPS. Margin target: 35-45% after infra. I'll draft numbers if product picks bands.

tara_legal: Contract points: clarify whether "guarantee" is operational guarantee or contractual SLA with credits. Define exclusions (maintenance, region outage, customer misconfig). Add a cap on monthly credits. Also require explicit language on fallback behavior when we route to non-reserved capacity.

jess_pm: Proposed launch gating checklist: 
- 2 pilot customers signed to a banded SKU
- Console: reservation UI + per-lane metrics
- Runtime: graceful fallback policy implemented and tested
- Billing: line-item and invoice display ready
- SLA: legal-approved draft with credit table
- Ops runbook for exhaustion scenarios

liam_eng: Engineering MVP checklist: 
```
- API: POST /gtl/reserve {route, band, start, duration}
- Routing: honor "gtl_lane" tag in proxy, prefer reserved pool
- Enforcement: per-lane token-bucket + overflow queue
- Metrics: gtl_reserved, gtl_used, gtl_downgraded, gtl_queue_latency
- Testing: chaos test where reserved pool loses 30% capacity
```
We can cut scope by making reservations fixed-month bands for MVP.

omar_sre: Ops will build a small synthetic test harness to validate 99p latency at 1.5x load in staging. Also need alerts when reserved usage < 30% to flag wasted capacity.

rae_sales: Pilot offering idea: 50% first-month credit + one SE migration day. Keep terms short to reduce legal friction. Also create a one-pager: value = reduced tail latency + predictable billing.

norm_finance: If pilots convert at 65% utilization on average, bands make sense. If utilization is <40% we need consumption rebates or a lower entry price. I'll model both scenarios.

tara_legal: Also recommend a short addendum for pilots that limits lifetime liability and clarifies transition to GA terms. Keep credit caps conservative.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pushed gtl-proxy branch to staging cluster at 2025-03-10T12:02Z — smoke tests passed :white_check_mark:

jess_pm: Decisions from this thread: prefer banded SKU for clarity, offer pilot discount, require 2 pilots + SLO verification + billing + legal sign-off before GA. Action owners: Liam = engineering epic + timeline, Norm = P&L bands, Tara = pilot addendum draft, Rae = pilot customer shortlist, Omar = staging test harness. Follow-up meeting Friday 9am PT.

liam_eng: I'll drop the epic and a first-cut ticket list today. If anyone sees an operational risk I missed ping me here.

rae_sales: Reaching out to @beta-payments and @atlas-retail for pilots now.

jess_pm: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as record — please add short updates here rather than new threads. :sparkles:
